label.en: If a player kills the Stellar Devourer

bridges.evidence: on_ship_destroyed_perp (00_on_actions.txt:1452) -> leviathans.1016 (leviathans_events_2.txt:784-813): victim is the guardian_stellarite country, ship flag stellarite_ship, system flagged stellarite_present and not yet stellarite_slain

label.zh: 恒星被重新点燃（成功 70% / 失败 30%）

note.zh: 进入事件时掷 70:30：成功则 EXCELLENT——恒星体积+12，冰冻行星改造为盖亚/温暖世界；失败则科学家死亡、科研舰队被毁，只有 UNFORTUNATE 选项：恒星体积+8，行星部分升温。
note.en: A 70:30 roll on entry: success shows EXCELLENT (star +12 size, frozen planets warmed, one becomes a Gaia world); failure kills the scientist and destroys the fleet and shows UNFORTUNATE (star +8, planets only partly warmed).

label.en: Stoke the star or harvest energy

note.zh: 收割遗骸可获得每月能量、矿物与影响力，故事就此结束；另一选择启用“物归原主”项目。
note.en: Harvesting the remains yields monthly energy, minerals and influence and ends the story; the other choice enables the project Back From Whence It Came.

notes.zh: 审阅注：第一个进入标有 guardians_stellarite_system 的星系的舰队触发（on_entering_system_fleet，00_on_actions.txt:1012）。星系行星立刻获得低温修正；7天后（leviathans.1000）噬星者及其国家生成。同一星系只会触发一次（guardians_stellarite_about_to_spawn）。
notes.en: Review note: fires for the first fleet entering a system flagged guardians_stellarite_system (on_entering_system_fleet, 00_on_actions.txt:1012). Planets there get a low-temperature modifier at once; 7 days later leviathans.1000 spawns the Devourer and its country. It fires once per system (guardians_stellarite_about_to_spawn).

notes.zh: 审阅注：玩家在噬星者所在之处（包括它游荡到的其他星系）看到它时的通知；每个玩家一次（guardians_stellarite_encountered）。噬星者每进入新星系，隐藏事件 1005 会把高温修正移到那里。
notes.en: Review note: notice when a player first sees the Devourer, including in systems it roams into; once per empire (guardians_stellarite_encountered). Hidden event 1005 moves the high-temperature modifier to whichever system it enters.

notes.zh: 审阅注：选项 a 与 c 互为替代：a 启用研究项目（60天），c 取走卵鞘并开启庆典情境。在庆典中途事件 1120 仍可再启用同一项目（见庆典故事）。
notes.en: Review note: options a and c are alternatives: a enables the 60-day study project, c retrieves the egg sac and starts the celebration situation. The celebration event 1120 can still enable the same project later (see that story).

scope.zh: 完整：出现、遭遇通知、击杀、两个项目与结局。隐藏的战斗/温度事件 1005–1015 只作说明。
scope.en: Complete: spawn, encounter notice, kill, both projects and endings. Hidden combat/temperature events 1005-1015 are noted only.

uncertain: The combat behaviour of the hidden events leviathans.1009-1015 (stellarite heat/repair mechanics) was not modelled.
